q: Pam, pemampat, mesin larik dan mesin pengisar dikategorikan sebagai jentera:
e: Types: power-generating (boilers, pressure vessels, prime movers); power-transmitting (gears, pulleys, belts, shafts); power-driven (pumps, compressors, lathes, milling machines, drills, crushers, grinders, mixers).

q: Penggerak utama (prime movers) seperti enjin, turbin dan motor tergolong dalam jentera:
e: Power-generating machinery: steam boilers, pressure vessels, prime movers (engines, turbines, motor).

q: Bahagian jentera yang membekalkan kuasa atau pergerakan kepada bahagian operasi (contoh daya motor) dipanggil:
e: Machinery parts: operative/functional – implements output (blade on chain saw); non-operative – supplies power or movement (motor).

q: Menurut Seksyen 15(2)(a), 'sistem kerja selamat' berkaitan dengan:
c: Permit kerja, latihan, SOP dan toolbox
e: Sec 15(2)(a): plant properly maintained; safe working system relates to work permit, training, SOP, toolbox and others.

q: Di bawah Seksyen 24 OSHA, pekerja yang mengendalikan jentera perlu:
c: Berhati-hati demi keselamatan diri dan orang lain yang mungkin terjejas oleh tindakannya
e: Sec 24(a): take reasonable care for the safety and health of himself and other persons affected by his acts or omissions.

q: Di bawah Seksyen 20(1), pereka, pengilang dan pembekal jentera perlu:
c: Mengatur pengujian dan pemeriksaan serta menyediakan maklumat yang mencukupi
e: Sec 20(1): (a) designed to be safe, (b) testing and examination, (c) adequate information, (d) research to minimise hazards, (e) safe erection or installation.

q: Membengkok, menekan, menempa dan menggelek ialah aktiviti jentera kategori:
e: Machinery activities: cutting (shearing, sawing, drilling); shaping/forming (bending, pressing, forging, rolling); joining (welding, riveting); lifting; mixing; transporting; surface treatment; packaging; maintenance; inspection.

q: Bahaya 'memotong' (cutting) melibatkan sentuhan dengan:
c: Permukaan tajam seperti gergaji, bilah atau cakera
e: Cutting: contact with sharp surfaces – saw, blade, disc; hands or body may contact sharp moving parts.

q: Pemotong mesin pengisar (milling cutter) dan pengisar cakera (disc grinder) ialah contoh bahaya:
e: Cutting examples: cutter for milling machine, disc grinder, band saw, circular saw.

q: Bahaya ricih (shearing) boleh berlaku antara:
c: Bahagian mesin statik dan bahagian bergerak
e: Shearing: between two moving parts, between machine part and material, or between static and moving machine parts.

q: Mata gerudi yang menebuk kulit apabila tangan terlalu hampir ialah contoh bahaya:
e: Stabbing and puncturing: drill bits can puncture skin if hands are too close to the rotating bit.

q: Lengan robot dan meja mesin pengisar yang bergerak lalu memukul badan tanpa menembusinya ialah contoh bahaya:
e: Impact: object or machine part hits the body but does not puncture or pierce it – e.g. robotic arm, milling machine table.

q: Penghantar skru (screw conveyor) dan aci berputar ialah contoh bahaya:
e: Entanglement examples: screw conveyor, shaft, drill.

q: Mesin pengamplas (sanding machine) dan pengisar dikaitkan dengan bahaya:
e: Friction or abrasion examples: grinder, sanding machine – burns or tear on skin's outer layer.

q: Pekerja yang tersepit antara mesin dan dinding mengalami bahaya:
e: Crushing: body crushed between two hard objects/machine parts, e.g. between machine and wall; power press, table lifter.

q: Bahaya 'penarikan masuk' (drawing in) berlaku apabila:
c: Badan ditarik ke arah mesin dan terperangkap di antara bahagian bergerak
e: Drawing in: body pulled towards the machine and trapped between moving parts – loose threads, gloves, hair.

q: Jenis kemalangan jentera yang disenaraikan termasuk:
c: Tersentuh bahan atau bahagian mesin yang terpelanting
e: Types of accidents: trapped between machine and object, entangled in machine part/material, contact with ejected parts or materials, release of potential energy.

q: Dalam kes mesin pengisar daging Melaka (2019), mangsa sedang melakukan:
c: Kerja penyelenggaraan bersama tiga rakan sekerja
e: Victim (47-year-old Nepalese) was performing maintenance on the meat-mincing machine with three co-workers; the machine was not properly isolated.

q: Dalam hierarki kawalan bahaya jentera, 'mengubah cara orang bekerja di sekitar mesin' ialah kawalan:
e: Control: elimination, substitution, isolation, engineering (physical changes), administrative (change the way people work), PPE (last).

q: Selepas menghentikan mesin, membunyikan amaran, memberi pertolongan cemas dan mengamankan kawasan, langkah kecemasan seterusnya ialah:
c: Melaporkan kepada pejabat JKKP terdekat bagi kecederaan serius atau kejadian berbahaya
e: Emergency: stop & isolate, raise alarm, first aid, secure area, report to nearest DOSH, investigate, correct & prevent.
